title: Wolf skewer
content:
# Wolf skewer

Type: Food | Internal ID: WolfMeatSkewer | Source: Cauldron, (level 3) | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Wolf meat x1, Mushroom x2, Onion x1 | Max Health: 65 | Max Stamina: 21 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Wolf skewer is a Mountain-tier food.

## Recipe

Wolf skewer is produced at a level 3 Cauldron with:
• 1 Wolf meat
• 2 Mushroom
• 1 Onion

### Crafting

• Hearty Mountain logger's stew

## Notes

• Wolf skewer provides the second-highest health gain in the Mountains at 65, second to Serpent stew at 80.

Categorias: Food
